deviations: As edge/run_edge.py runs it: the isolated compose project birka-edge-check (CI: the file's own `birka`), Caddy published on 58080/58443 instead of 80/443 (edge/override.yml), every http://localhost in the steps becomes http://localhost:58080; BIRKA_DOMAIN stays http://localhost; BIRKA_BACKUP_DIR is edge/backups. The port check reads the config merged with the runner's two files, which touch only caddy's ports and the builds.

Images: a third compose file (work/edge/edge-offline.yml) sets `pull_policy: never` on every service with an image (postgres:17-alpine, caddy:2-alpine come from the local image store, never pulled; CI pulls them fresh), pins every build's base image to the digest in the local build cache and passes a dead HTTP(S) proxy as build args, so a step that would download fails; `docker run --pull never`.
BIRKA_RELEASE is the full HEAD commit, as github.sha is in CI.
Afterwards the stack is removed (`docker compose --profile ops down -v --remove-orphans`, project birka-edge-check only); its images are kept.

steps.name: Caddy accepts the Caddyfile, as a server with a real domain reads it
Build the images and start the stack
The API is ready behind the edge, healthy to Docker, and keeps its internals in
Sign-ins are counted per real address, whatever a client claims
The edge's own log keeps no query string
A new bundle keeps the previous one's files and drops month-old ones
